title: Legal Metrology Packaged Food Commodities Special Rules

rules.name: Best Before / Expiry Declaration
rules.description: For pre-packaged food commodities, 'Best Before' or 'Use By' date must be stated alongside manufacturing date.
rules.failure_message: Best before or Expiry date declaration not found on prepackaged food commodity.
rules.remediation: Print 'Best Before 6 Months from Mfg' or specific expiry MM/YYYY date.

rules.name: Veg / Non-Veg Indicator Symbol
rules.description: Mandatory green dot / brown triangle indicator for packaged consumable food items under FSSAI harmonization.
rules.failure_message: Vegetarian or non-vegetarian logo emblem not detected.
rules.remediation: Display the green circle in green bordered square for vegetarian food or brown triangle for non-vegetarian.
